race.comment: LADY BLANC (11) is from the canny Busuttin/Young camp and gets here after a couple of jumpouts, finishing fourth at the first before a second last time out. The low draw brings her right into it. THE SHERIFF (13) did little in the only run of the debut, when he started double-figure odds, but has trialled well since and it was interesting to note there was immediate market support. NO DRAMA (5) is on debut for Ben Brisbourne and won a jumpout last preparation before showing sharp improvement to win another at her second jumpout this time in. She looks ready to go. BEAST FIGHTER (1) will be better for a couple of appearance and should have come on from the adequate first-up effort. CELESTRA (3) ran some nice races in stronger races than this last prep and should get all the favours from the draw.
